test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five people V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row facing towards north. W is sitting at the extreme left end of the row. There are two people sitting between Z and W. V is immediate neighbour of Z . X is immediate neighbour of V. Exactly how many people are sitting in between W and Y?
solution: Five people V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row facing towards north. 1. W is sitting at the extreme left end of the row. 2. There are two people sitting between Z and W. 3. V is immediate neighbour of Z . 4. X is immediate neighbour of V. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/add2513239403bbf29c1c21141d14b1c3a1c0e6ede651b18cfba1cdcbc5a89d0.png]
